head: f5696fb8b70547e49b0ac6e2a5489e8fde8e10be
label: split-c100
purpose: TASK-139 submit transaction segment timing (instrumentation only, behavior unchanged)

instrument.note: select segment covers HikariCP pool wait + idempotency SELECT (pool of 10 under concurrency 100); commit segment covers actual commit incl. redo fsync; updateStatus segment exists only in pre-change code (SUBMITTED->VERIFYING optimistic-lock UPDATE inside submit transaction)

baselineReference.note: split run within noise of TASK-138 baseline; behavior unchanged

reading.txWorkP50usApproxFormula: insertMain + trackWrite + updateStatus + commit (excl. pool wait)
reading.poolWaitShare: select P50 681.6ms of ~738ms in-tx wall per request is HikariCP queue wait (pool 10, concurrency 100); TASK-138 inference (9/10 of observed P50 is pool wait, T_tx ~80ms) confirmed by direct measurement, in-tx work P50 ~56.5ms
reading.updateStatusShare: updateStatus P50 2.1ms is ~4% of in-tx work; removing it shrinks T_tx and hence pool-wait multiple, expected small QPS/P50 improvement
reading.commitShare: commit P50 28.9ms is the largest in-tx segment (redo fsync floor); NOT addressable in this change (innodb flush overlay explicitly out of scope)
reading.trackWriteShare: trackWrite P50 22.6ms includes ShardingSphere multi-row INSERT parse/route + sql-show printing (30KB-class statement string per request); sql-show default-off (this change) removes the printing share

snapshotSource: logs/record.log SUBMIT_TX_TIMING line at samples=2000 (out of 2010 incl. warmup); snapshots are cumulative aggregates

correctionTask140.evidenceGrade: select segment is MIXED (physical connection acquisition wait + idempotency SELECT); reading.poolWaitShare 'confirmed by direct measurement' is downgraded to inference. commit segment is the beforeCommit->afterCommit interval (incl. network round-trip), NOT a pure fsync item; fsync share 未分离测得 (not separately measured). Per-segment P50s must not be summed into a per-request latency. Single before/after run with a double change cannot attribute gains to either item.
correctionTask140.directMeasurement: request-level connWait (physical connection acquisition incl. Hikari pool wait, measured at inner-pool acquisition point) P50 527.1ms under the same load, see docs/perf/复测-db-wait-evidence.md
